evidence.claim: Adobe says it may infer or generate information from data it collects and combine information you provide with third-party sources.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 26.8.3.49043 (report dated Sept. 19, 2026) found code signatures for 9 known tracker SDK(s): Adobe Experience Cloud, Branch (analytics), Facebook Analytics (analytics), Facebook Login (identification), Facebook Share, Google AdMob (advertisement), Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), OpenTelemetry (OpenCensus, OpenTracing) (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
